title: Use Modifications Along Austin Street
previewText: Within C2 Districts fronting on Austin Street in the Special Forest Hills District, the use regulations shall be modified to permit uses listed under Use Groups VI and VIII, pursuant to the regulations applicable to C4 Districts.
